name: Bathran's Haunt
summary: Forsaken herbalists now harvest rare plants at Bathran's Haunt, east of the Zoram Strand in northwestern Ashenvale. Their work is withering the woodland around the ancient kaldorei ruin.

sections.title: A Blighted Refuge in the Ancient Woods
sections.body: At Bathran's Haunt, crumbling night elf pillars stand north of the Ruins of Ordil'Aran, tangled in Ashenvale's thick foliage. Once a tranquil kaldorei relic, the ruin now shelters Forsaken herbalists and their enforcers. They work among the broken marble in an open-air laboratory, harvesting rare woodland reagents for their experiments. The grass rots brown, blossoms wilt, and decay creeps through the grove as their work blights the ancient soil.

sections.title: The Harvest of Bathran's Hair
sections.body: Bathran's Hair, a unique remedial herb, grows only among these stones. Night elf and Alliance scouts see its harvest as a desecration of sacred elven soil, while Forsaken herbalists seek the plant's potent properties. The Horde has an interest in the herb's yield, but the Forsaken keep their methods secret. The corruption of the earth draws suspicion from outsiders and allies alike.

aliases: how to get to bathrans haunt
faq.answer: Bathran's Haunt lies in northwestern Ashenvale, north of the Ruins of Ordil'Aran and inland, east of the Zoram Strand.

aliases: what are undead doing in ashenvale
why are forsaken at bathrans haunt
faq.answer: Forsaken herbalists have set up an encampment and laboratory among the ruins to gather and study the forest's unique plants, especially Bathran's Hair, a rare remedial herb.
Bathran's Hair is a distinctive, valuable remedial herb with potent restorative qualities. It grows only among the crumbling stones of Bathran's Haunt.

faq.q: Why is the ground dying around the ruins?
faq.answer: The Forsaken's presence and alchemical work have corrupted the ground near the ruins. Grass withers brown, and woodland flowers die.

angles.text: The Forsaken encampment at Bathran's Haunt defiles kaldorei heritage: undead intruders occupy ancient elven stonework and blight sacred soil.
Bathran's Haunt is the only known habitat for Bathran's Hair, a unique remedial herb sought for its rare restorative properties.
